title: Axis-anchored event-relation masked-training corrective readiness
purpose: Qualify the unchanged 819196-parameter model with masked early relation targets, frozen fit-only class weights and split core/identity losses required by full-population training.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 corrective zero-training readiness run on the same seven fixed C01 observations; no optimizer, checkpoint, C07/C08 selection, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and delegated best in-scope method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed deduplicated C01-C08 causal LiDAR/Teacher dataset.
Sealed V1 model readiness and Teacher feasibility evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.provenance_population: The full approved development population remains 80 C01-C08 worlds; V1R reads only the unchanged two C01 parents.

sampling.rule: Reuse the V1 fixed batch. Additionally mark its first two relation positions unlabeled, provide current branch presence independently, and apply immutable inverse-square-root weights derived only from the formally audited C01-C06 counts.

teacher.source: Frozen TNG event/association/directed-exit identity and spline/mesh geometry in the dataset.
teacher.valid_mask: A relation pair is labeled only when both referenced raw frames have observation-level exit Teacher rows in the same traversal; current branch and geometry masks are independent.
teacher.student_input: Only five normalized range and valid-return images.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is run; nodes later require stable learned events and edges physical traversal.

split.fit: Only fixed C01 rows; no fit or optimizer occurs.
split.historical_pollution_audit: V1 evidence is component provenance only; no checkpoint exists or is loaded.

methods.main: Unchanged axis-anchored model; core batches use masked event/relation/geometry loss and independent identity-balanced batches use place/branch contrastive loss.
methods.baseline: V1 combined-loss readiness on the same real batch.
methods.fallback: Any masked-target, class-weight, split-loss, finite-gradient or prior V1 invariant failure stops before training.

failure_policy: Do not delete early frames, fabricate missing relations, change model parameters, relax rotation, optimize, checkpoint, access C07-C10/M-TARE or enter graph/planner.
retention: Retain corrective summary, fixed manifest, paper-ready figure/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Two deterministic CUDA forward/backward checks on seven real observations
